1.note: Lake Avernus lies silent and lifeless in the Rocky Mountains while savants argue over where its water goes
Flin Flon the grocer is introduced and his person and habits described
Flin and his party row round Lake Avernus in a small boat and find it bottomless
Flin addresses the packed hall of the Society in New York and proposes to descend into Lake Avernus

2.note: New York wakes to the news of Flin's proposal and the papers and Wall Street talk of nothing else
Flin superintends the building of his fish vessel at the engineers' works
The finished fish is on view at Barnum's Museum and its workings are described
Barnum gives a grand banquet for Flin at Astor House with the ladies in the gallery
The guests leave the banquet and go out into the dark streets

3.note: Flin rides a white elephant through the crowded streets of New York in the procession
The expedition boards the train at the station and steams away amid cheering crowds
On the shore of Lake Avernus Flin bids his friends farewell, enters the fish and sinks out of sight

4.note: Flin descends in the fish vessel through Lake Avernus and lodges on a rock ledge for the night
Morning on the ledge, Flin breakfasts and studies the strange creatures clinging to the rock wall
The fish slides off the ledge and is sucked spinning down into the mouth of the subterranean river
The fish is swept along the underground river through a tunnel and Flin dines and goes to bed
Flin wakes at night as the fish strikes a rock and is carried down a rapid and over a waterfall
The fish lies jammed in a cove at the foot of the waterfall and Flin unscrews the door
Flin lights magnesium wire, sees the great stalactite cavern and steps out onto its floor

5.note: Flin stands in the cavern by the rushing river and the waterfall and fixes a torch beside the moored fish
Flin wanders through the petrified forest of white stone trees and loses his way
Flin comes out on a treeless plain of stone and measures the bones of giants and a behemoth
Flin finds a second river full of blind fish and follows it downstream
Flin returns to the moored fish, eats, writes his diary and sleeps
Next morning Flin inspects the dented fish and puzzles how to get it out of the pool beneath the fall

6.note: Flin clambers along the rocks beside the waterfall and tows the fish into a cove
Flin boards the fish, dives beneath the waterfall and is spun in the maelstrom until he faints
Flin wakes in the steady fish drifting through a glittering tunnel and writes his diary until he sleeps
Flin wakes in oppressive heat as a red glow fills the tunnel
The river opens into a vast hall of jewelled pillars and Flin moors the fish and steps ashore

7.note: Flin lays a paper trail from his vessel on the river and studies the jewelled hall of pillars
Flin climbs and crawls through the low honeycomb cavern away from the river
Flin kneels on the brink of a fiery gulf, the bed of a living volcano, and leaves a bottle with his name in it
Flin retraces his paper trail, lies down on the rock and dreams of being tried in Pluto's court
Flin reaches the river again and finds his vessel gone

8.note: Flin wakes from his swoon beside the river where his vessel was moored
Flin follows the river bank downstream as the cavern grows dark
Flin sits on a mound of rock in the dark and creeps toward two gleaming eyes at the water's edge

9.note: Flin strips and swims out to his vessel wedged between two pillars in the stream
Flin steers the fish out of the pillars into a tunnel and sinks it to the bottom to sleep
Flin wakes, breakfasts and is driven fast through the narrow tunnel by a rushing wind
The vessel is swept down a rapid, strikes rock and rises into a deafening roar

10.note: Inside and then on top of the fish in the cavern of the Waters of Fire, where blue flames burst from the lake and the pigeon dies
The fish rushes down a steep dark tunnel on the swift underground river while Flin fights sleep
The tunnel opens out and the fish is swept toward a roaring cauldron of water and fire

11.note: Inside the fish, tossed through the whirlpool, then waking bruised among the wreckage of the cabin
Flin steps out onto the fish beside a ledge of rock and sees the Sea of Echoes under coloured clouds
Flin sets sail and runs along the coast of waterfalls toward the smoke on the horizon
In rough sea by the barrier reef where the river from Lake Avernus bursts out as a giant waterspout
Moored at the ledge, Flin walks the black shore, shoots at a giant turtle, hears the echo, and christens the Sea of Echoes

12.note: Inside the fish moored on the Sea of Echoes, Flin wakes sore, brews punch, and finds the air charged with electricity
An electric storm bursts over the Sea of Echoes with sheets of flame and thunder that shakes the rocks
The storm passes and Flin moors at the rocks to sew himself a suit from blankets and sheets
Flin hoists the sail and flag and runs along the coast and across open sea to a new coast where he moors for the night
Next day Flin sails fast along the new coast on a strong current toward a great headland
The fish is swept through a narrow channel between black rock walls lit blood red
The river carries the fish through a colossal doorway in a mountain into a dark tunnel

13.note: The fish is swept down a dark rock tunnel by a fast current
The vessel shoots out of the tunnel onto an open river between banks of ferns, palms and flowers
Flin moors in a small bay of a lagoon, sleeps, and watches night fall with fireflies over the water
Next morning Flin sails on down the broadening river through jungle to a wide plain of gold
Flin lands in a cove on the plain of solid gold and frantically loads his vessel with it
Flin casts off with the vessel crammed with gold, drifts on the river and falls asleep on the floor

14.note: Flin wakes in the golden throne hall of King Gubmuh before a crowd of tailed courtiers and is mesmerised by the priest

15.note: Flin sits on a stool in the throne hall while the priest Ytidrusba questions and lectures him before the King and court

16.note: Flin wakes alone in the gold audience hall of the palace and the priest comes to him
In an ante-room of the palace Flin learns the language, quarrels with Ytidrusba, eats, and reads the Gazette

17.note: In a gold room of the palace the savants examine Flin on a table and Dr. Yrekcauq lectures on him

18.note: The lecture ends and the savants leave the conference room
In the magician's apartment Ytidrusba runs down the Doctor and plots with Flin to win the Princess

19.note: Ytidrusba leads Flin through the palace corridors and across a courtyard to another wing
In the Princess's apartment Yobmot flirts with Flin and he asks her to stop the exhibition, and the King walks in

20.note: In the Princess's apartment Yobmot wheedles the King into granting Flin his liberty, then waltzes Flin round the room

21.note: The city of Esnesnon buzzes over Flin's arrival and the Anti-Humbug News prints its article
Flin reads the newspaper article in the palace and smiles

22.note: Princess Yobmot bursts into Flin's room in the palace, teases him, and orders her chariot to take him to the Society meeting

23.note: Flin and the Princess ride through the town in her electric chariot while she makes love to him
They climb the ruby stairs of a gold building and a servant announces them at the door
In the meeting room of the Society for the Protection of Males, seventy ladies stare at Flin and fall to squabbling

24.note: The Society meeting goes on, the Princess in the chair, while Mrs Sregdorpittemmocaig quarrels with the board over a chariot-driver's case

25.note: Flin reads the newspaper war between the two court factions
Flin persuades Ytidrusba to let him speak to his wife

26.note: Flin talks the reluctant magician into letting him call on Mrs Ytidrusba
Flin argues with Mrs Ytidrusba in her room and she has the Amazons arrest him

27.note: The guard hurries Flin through the streets in a closed carriage to the citadel
Flin is thrust into a dark dungeon and mutters about his scrape
The King hears of the arrest and dares not act against Mrs Ytidrusba
Flin languishes in gaol while the officials delay his case
The Parliament of a thousand women wrangles over the case
Flin waits in prison while Parliament indicts him for treason
Princess Yobmot returns and visits Flin in his cell the day before the trial

28.note: The Princess visits Flin in the room where he is confined and promises him the best counsel
Flin stands trial for treason in the packed amphitheatre court and the prosecution makes its opening speech

29.note: Hturtehteraps makes her speech for the defence in the crowded court and the judges acquit Flin

30.note: The judges and ladies crowd round Flin in the court to congratulate him on his acquittal
A banquet in an ante-room where the Princess and the ladies make speeches over lunch
Alone in the Princess's chariot she declares her love and Flin agrees to be hers

31.note: The city in uproar after the trial, with twenty thousand Amazons quartered in the streets
Four masked women take a male from his home at night
Parliament debates whether to banish Flin
Flin goes about the town learning the customs of Esnesnon
The King and Ytidrusba worn down at court while Flin resolves on a revolution and a way home
Flin petitions Parliament for leave to explore the cavern in the mountain

32.note: Flin prepares the expedition and the Princess begs him not to go
Flin and his band of old males march across the plain as the Princess waves from the castle tower
A four day voyage on an electric ship across the sea to Cape Desolation
The party walks the rim of a dead volcanic basin of black rock
An electric storm breaks over the crater while the travellers shelter in a rock opening
The climb up the mountain through the clouds and a ravine to the mouth of the mammoth cavern
Flin and six males climb for days through the galleries inside the mountain until the air goes bad
Back down to the cave mouth and the return to Esnesnon

33.note: The city grumbles at the wasted expedition while Flin quietly enjoys his find
Flin confides in Ytidrusba and has the breathing dress, water box and biscuits made
Flin slips out of the city by night and stores his gear at the mountain
The Princess frets over Flin's disappearance and the King issues a proclamation
Flin returns to the palace and the Princess hugs him
An upper world lady wastes away under the burden of a secret
On a stormy October night the lady dies in her bed after telling Nellie the secret

34.note: In the palace the Princess Yobmot falls under Flin's influence and learns to love him
Flin works in secret with the King and Ytidrusba, winning men to the conspiracy
Flin tells the Princess that man should rule and wins her over with a confession of love
The conspirators rejoice at the Princess joining them and fix the hour for the coup

35.note: The Princess struggles against Flin's hold on her and yields to it
The conspirators meet nightly while spies of the Government grow suspicious
The members of Parliament shriek and quarrel over the news of the plot and order Flin's arrest
Flin withdraws to the palace with troops the Princess has won over
The women of the city rage in stormy meetings and resolve to besiege the palace
The besiegers batter the palace for weeks while the besieged make sorties and fight back
Inside the besieged palace the King wastes away and dies and Ytidrusba follows him
Under cover of darkness Flin and the Princess slip out of the palace and hurry toward the mountain

36.note: The fugitives flee unmolested toward the mountain
They rest at the mouth of the cavern and then climb the dark galleries upward for days
On the shore of a subterranean lake the Princess dies in Flin's arms
Flin climbs on alone through the burnt galleries until he sees daylight
Flin emerges at the bottom of a huge crater with a lake and blue sky far above
Flin climbs to the mountain summit, descends into a valley and meets a party of gold diggers
Flin reaches San Francisco and is seized by the police and held as a madman for a year
Flin gives receptions at Barnum's Museum in New York and is called an impostor
